headline: A 1996 executive order that set policy for how federal agencies manage and use information technology.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President Clinton on July 16, 1996, deals with how the federal government handles its computers and information technology. Based on the title alone, it sets rules or goals for how agencies plan, buy, and manage technology. No summary was provided, so the specific requirements are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their technology managers
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to follow new policies on how they plan for, buy, and manage information technology.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 16, 1996; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
